title: Federated retrieval across <domain>-knowledge Qdrant collections
rationale: Each of the 13 domain chats builds its own Qdrant collection (lathe-knowledge, mill-knowledge, wedm-knowledge, cad-knowledge, ...). Cross-domain queries today fail because no single collection has the answer; today's RAG layer can't fan out. Federation lets a query from any domain reach all collections, rerank, and return a unified result.

units.title: QdrantFederatedRetrieverEngine — fans query to N collections in parallel
Domain-affinity weighting — boost collections matching the query's inferred domain
BM25 fallback per-collection when dense retrieval is sparse
End-to-end test — cross-domain query 'how do tribal chatter rules apply to lathe?' surfaces foxtrot + whiskey hits

exit_gate.all_13_collections_federated: query hits all 13 domain collections in parallel
exit_gate.rerank_quality: MRR@10 > 0.5 on operator-curated cross-domain test set
exit_gate.latency_ms: <800ms p95 for fanout + rerank across 13 collections
exit_gate.fallback_path: BM25 fallback fires when any collection returns < 3 dense hits

summary: Federated retrieval over 13 per-domain Qdrant collections. RRF reranking + domain-affinity weighting + BM25 fallback. Foundation for cross-domain reasoning (e.g. lathe chatter advice informed by mill-tribal rules).
